notes.title: Say helloaphant to The Elephant Collection!
notes.content:
Helloaphant, Crush the Castle fans! We have some very big news for you:
The elephant games are back!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41783987/b974e9f83a93b3e4f242dda29eca1c5992faea95.gif

We've taken ten of jmtb02's elephant-themed Flash classics and bundled them all in a remastered collection just for you! The Elephant Collection features the This is the Only Level games; the Achievement Unlocked games; Elephant Quest; Obey! the Game; Run, Elephant, Run; and Elephant Rave. Plus, we've included a very lovingly-made metagame to tie the whole collection together!

The Elephant Collection is coming soon to a PC near you.

Relive your childhood and watch the trailer here:
[previewyoutube=-Hf91nIk3zI;full][/previewyoutube]

Wishlist The Elephant Collection on Steam for updates!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2274110/The_Elephant_Collection/
